messages:
meera: Heads-up, onboarding `guanaco-13b` hit a weird conversion failure. HF->Redwood converter errored when assembling safetensors shards and tokenization outputs mismatch.
meera: Error snippet:
```
IndexError: index 3 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 3
during safetensors shard concat: shard_0003.safetensors
```
meera: Also tokenizer says unk_token missing after we applied the model's chat template. outputs are full of <unk> even though config.json lists "bos_token" only.
sam: Oof. Did converter respect the hub revision pin? We had pinned to v2.1 in the manifest.
meera: I thought so but logs show it pulled at HEAD. hf-download-bot: pulled model guanaco-13b from hf.co/org/guanaco at rev `main` (auth token scenari0) — note: repo is partially gated.
sam: That would explain key mismatch. Newer checkpoint renamed weight keys `layer_X.attn.q_proj` -> `layer_X.attn.q` in main. Converter's rename map expects the old names.
josh: For the safetensors IndexError — I think our assemble code assumes shards are contiguous and small. The HF safetensors index can list offsets not in order; need streaming concat instead of loading all into memory+np.concatenate.
dani: Re: tokenizer: some HF chat templates override special tokens by relying on `tokenizer.set_special_tokens` applied at load time via the model card. Converter only reads tokenizer.json and ignores `added_tokens.json` and `special_tokens_map.json` sometimes.
meera: Repro steps I ran:
```
rlc convert --source hf://org/guanaco/guanaco-13b --revision v2.1 --out /tmp/guanaco_rf
# but logs show: rev fallback -> main
```
meera: Patch idea: pass `--revision` through to hf_hub_download and validate using `git ls-remote` or the hub API before download.
sam: Agreed. For weight keys, we should ship a small mapping file per model: `weight_key_map.json` that converter applies if present.
josh: For safetensors, quick fix: change shard assembly to stream shards in index order using the `offsets` in the `.index` file instead of naive np.concatenate. Also add checksum validation.
dani: For tokenizer fix: load `special_tokens_map.json` & `added_tokens.json` and merge with tokenizer.json. Also, if chat_template references tokens not present, emit a warning and fall back to defaults instead of leaving <unk>.
meera: I pushed a small repro and a failing test to branch `meera/conv-revpin-shard` (PR #3122). It includes the HF repo fixture (private) and a pointer to the problematic shards.
sam: I'll take the revpin + hub auth bit. Plan: ensure hf_hub_download is invoked with `revision` param and `token` env if needed, and verify returned commit hash.
josh: I'll tackle safetensors streaming and checksum.
dani: I'll add tokenizer merge logic and a unit test for chat templates referencing missing special tokens.
meera: Thanks. One more: add a converter warning when tokenizer and model vocab size differ >128 tokens — we hit that and it masked itself as generation garbage.
sam: Good call. Also log the model commit hash in converted metadata so we can trace versions in infra.
meera: I'll add the metadata field and update the onboarding checklist.
hf-download-bot: Note: private repo download requires `HF_TOKEN` with read access. If you need a short-lived token, request from infra, scope `read:org/guanaco`.
meera: Cool. Filing follow-ups: #3122 (repro+test), #3123 (revpin+auth), #3124 (safetensors streaming), #3125 (tokenizer merge). Assigning owners as discussed.
meera: tl;dr: converter needs three fixes: enforce revision pin + auth, stream safetensors shards by index offsets with checksums, and merge special token files so chat templates don't produce <unk>."
